method.camera_angle: atan2(bob_x-pivot_x,pivot_y-bob_y), raw coordinates; stored theta_rad ignored
method.lag_convention: encoder evaluation time = camera t + lag; negative means image is older than read timestamp
method.lag_fit: first6s swing mode2 samples with |omega|>.5, jointly fit periodic angle map; frozen for later swing and all balance
method.geometry: per-run constant plus sin(q),cos(q),sin(2q),cos(2q); an empirical disagreement map, not identified encoder correction
method.holdout: later6-12s swing and all balance samples; no heldout refit
method.camera_filter: detected, confidence>=.7, raw marker separation>50px, age<.2s
method.reference: direct upright370 preserved; no gravity-zero inference
